_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a project of this core can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. Each kind is called a slot. A slot has a title, the number of files it takes (min and max, where a max of -1 means no limit), the file extensions it accepts and the help text shown to the user. Chimera shows the form and checks the chosen files against it. A project file records its files under the slot ids used here.

slots.title: Cartridge
slots.help: The NES cartridge file in iNES format (.nes).

slots.title: Save data
slots.help: The saved game that a cartridge with a battery starts with. This is the file that Emulator > Export Save Data... writes (battery.sav, the cartridge's 8 KB of save memory). Put it here to continue a run from where another one stopped. The file is never changed. The project and the movie record exactly which file it was, so a movie that starts from a saved game can be played back by anyone who has the same file. A cartridge with no battery keeps no saves, and the project says so. Leave this empty to start with a fresh cartridge.
